'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Matt Paragano DS Contract Killers''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Paragano]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Contract Killers / Feared Throughout The Galaxy|VB8-D-contractkillers-pre.gif}}
* '''Username:''' GunganStyle
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
